ourStory.subtitle: Our Journey
ourStory.title: The Chapters of Us
ourStory.description: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is our favorite editorial masterpiece.

items.description: Before we ever knew each other's names, fate had already written the first page of our story. Two children, complete strangers, unknowingly captured in separate moments of life—never imagining that one day, those innocent smiles would become part of the same love story. Looking back now, it feels as though destiny had been quietly introducing us long before we ever met.
items.title: Two Strangers, One Beautiful Beginning
The First Glance
items.description: Sometimes love begins with nothing more than a simple glance. During the college ball, we found ourselves wanting to capture a photo with someone who had unexpectedly caught each other's attention. At that moment, we had no idea that this picture would become the beginning of our lifetime together. It was just one photograph—but little did we know, it would one day hold so much meaning.

We officially became "us." No grand announcements, no social media posts—just two hearts quietly choosing each other. We treasured our little secret, enjoying every moment before the world knew. Somehow, though, love has a way of revealing itself. It wasn't long before our friends noticed that something beautiful was growing between us.
items.title: A Love Kept Between Us

items.description: Graduation marked more than the end of our college journey—it celebrated our first major milestone as a couple. As we stepped into a new chapter of life, we also chose to face the future side by side. From that day onward came years of challenges, sacrifices, victories, laughter, and countless ordinary moments that quietly built an extraordinary love. Through every season, we discovered that home was always found in each other.
items.title: Growing Together

items.description: For the first time, we welcomed a brand-new year hand in hand. As fireworks lit up the night sky, so did our dreams for the future. It wasn't simply the beginning of another year—it was the beginning of traditions, memories, and countless celebrations we promised to share together.
items.title: Our First New Year Together
The Sweetest Surprise
items.description: What I thought was an ordinary day turned into one of the most unforgettable moments of my life. With the help of our friends, he carefully planned every detail to create the perfect surprise. Then came the question that changed everything forever. Through happy tears and overwhelming joy, one simple word became the easiest answer I had ever given: "Yes."

Every chapter of our journey has led us here. From strangers to best friends, from secret lovers to soulmates, every step has prepared us for this beautiful day. Surrounded by the people we love most, we begin our greatest adventure—not as two separate stories, but as one.

On Dec 20, 2026, we will finally say, "I do."

This isn't the end of our story—it's the beginning of our happily ever after. ❤️
items.title: Our Forever Begins

dressCode.title: Formal Black Tie Optional
dressCode.description: To honor our vision of a beautiful, cohesive atmosphere in Tarlac, we respectfully request our guests to dress in harmony with our burgundy and gold color story.
dressCode.ladiesGuideline: Floor-length gowns or refined midi-cocktail dresses in shades of burgundy, blush, antique gold, or warm neutrals. Flowing silhouettes and romantic laces are highly welcomed.
dressCode.gentlemenGuideline: Classic dinner suit (Tuxedo) or tailored suit with crisp white dress shirts. Burgundy, antique gold, or black tailored coordinates. Bowties or silk ties matching the theme are preferred.

faqHeader.subtitle: Guest Information
faqHeader.title: Things You Might Want to Know
faqHeader.description: Quick answers for our beloved guests

faq.q: Can I bring a plus one?
faq.a: To help us maintain an accurate guest count, attendance is limited to individuals who have received a digital invitation and a unique RSVP code. Only guests included in the invitation and successfully registered using the provided code will be accommodated. Unfortunately, those who did not receive an invitation code are not included in our guest list. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we celebrate this special day with our invited family and friends.

To allow all our guests—including parents—a night of relaxation and uninhibited celebration, we have chosen for our wedding weekend to be an adults-only affair. We thank you in advance for your understanding and hope you can join us to raise a glass in comfort.
The ceremony will commence promptly at 3:00 PM. We recommend arriving 30 to 60 minutes prior (between 2:00 PM and 2:30 PM) to comfortably enjoy a welcome refreshment and find your seats.

Yes, the style guidelines are Formal Black Tie Optional. Gentlemen are encouraged to wear classic dinner suits (tuxedos) or tailored coordinates. Ladies are invited to wear floor-length or refined midi dresses matching our neutral palette.

faq.q: Can I take photos or videos?
faq.a: We respectfully request an "unplugged" ceremony where all phones and cameras remain off so that you can be fully present with us. You are more than welcome to capture memories during the cocktail hour and reception dinner!

faq.q: Where is the venue and is parking available?
faq.a: All celebrations take place within our designated venues in Paniqui, Tarlac. Secure valet and open parking spaces are fully accommodated at the entrance of both properties for all driving guests.

faq.q: Can I give gifts or cash?
faq.a: Your love, laughter, and presence on our special day are the greatest gifts we could receive. Should you wish to honor us with a contribution towards our new life together, details can be found in the registry section.

We understand that unforeseen circumstances may arise. If you are unable to attend, please submit your RSVP and select either "Regretfully Declines" or provide the details of your designated proxy, if applicable. Kindly note that only responses received through the RSVP system will be considered. Guests who do not submit an RSVP by the stated deadline will be assumed unable to attend, and their reserved seat may be released accordingly. Thank you for helping us finalize our guest arrangements.

faq.q: Who can I contact for questions?
faq.a: For any additional logistics or questions, please reach, at +63 995 179 2240 / +63 945 728 7481.
